After SoftBank Group acquired control of Arm in 2016, Arm gradually shifted from licensing the technology needed to manufacture chips to selling its own chips, altering the nature of the partnership.
The crux of the dispute is whether Qualcomm can reach an agreement with Arm on licensing terms for a new architecture before the existing Arm compute‑architecture license expires in 2033.

The controversy stems from Qualcomm’s 2021 acquisition of chip‑design firm Nuvia. Nuvia had previously obtained licenses for Arm‑related architectures, and Qualcomm hopes to integrate that technology into its own Oryon CPU architecture for PCs, smartphones and AI compute platforms.

Arm argues that the Nuvia licensing agreement does not automatically transfer to Qualcomm and demands that Qualcomm cease using the related technology. Qualcomm maintains that it already holds a valid Arm architecture license that runs through 2033.

Analysts note that the lawsuit highlights the widening strategic gap between Qualcomm and Arm. Arm historically partnered with chip designers by licensing CPU architectures, but in recent years has aggressively expanded into its own chip and system solutions, seeking to break out of the traditional licensing model.
Qualcomm, by integrating Nuvia’s technology, is bolstering its own CPU design capabilities and reducing reliance on external architecture licenses, turning the relationship increasingly competitive.

The verdict could shape how chip makers acquire and use CPU‑architecture licenses. If Arm wins, it could tighten its control over licensing terms; if Qualcomm prevails, it may encourage firms to obtain technology licenses through acquisitions and spur greater investment in in‑house CPU development.
On Friday, after roughly four hours of deliberation, the jury was still unable to reach a decision and indicated that deliberations would resume on Tuesday.

Qualcomm wants the jury to find that Arm withheld the software patches and tools needed for Qualcomm’s chip designs, violating their licensing agreement, and that Arm also breached a separate agreement that caps the price Qualcomm must pay for Arm processor designs at no more than ten percent above the minimum price.

Qualcomm also seeks a finding that Arm attempted to sabotage Qualcomm’s commercial partnership with Meta. Qualcomm alleges that in 2024 Arm leaked a letter to Bloomberg that accused Qualcomm of violating a key licensing agreement.

Arm’s legal team this week tried to steer the jury toward another claim—that Qualcomm suffered no damages from the allegations in the lawsuit. Arm describes the case as a fight over who controls licensing terms, with Qualcomm using the dispute to apply negotiating pressure.

This week the parties also pursued a separate judge‑run proceeding on whether Arm engaged in good‑faith negotiations over the licensing terms. That decision, however, is unlikely to be issued until after the jury reaches a verdict on Friday.

The case is being heard in the federal court in Wilmington, Delaware, and revisits many of the same issues from the 2024 trial, when Arm failed to convince the jury that Qualcomm had breached their licensing agreement.
Both trials featured testimony from Arm CEO Rene Haas and Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon, and were overseen by U.S. District Judge Maryellen Noreika.
Qualcomm attorney Karen Dunn told the court on Monday that the case is critical for Qualcomm.
She said, “This is very detrimental to us because Qualcomm’s entire chip business relies on Arm and on Arm honoring its contracts and commitments.”

Qualcomm had asked Judge Noreika before the trial began to rule that, under a clause in the licensing agreement, Qualcomm could stop paying royalties within five years if the contract were breached. The judge has not ruled on that, while Arm argues that the royalty‑penalty clause is unenforceable.
Arm lawyer Gregg LoCascio told the jury on Monday, “They have suffered no damage at all.”

Arm has long relied on intellectual‑property licensing as its core business model, unlike Intel (INTC-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US), which design their own CPU architectures. Arm primarily licenses CPU architectures to global chip makers such as Apple (AAPL-US), Qualcomm, MediaTek (2454-TW), Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and numerous automotive chip firms, which build their own processors on Arm’s designs.

Analysts warn that if this lawsuit upends existing industry practices, the way chip makers acquire Arm technology through acquisitions could become uncertain, affecting semiconductor M&A strategies, chip‑design business models and the overall IP‑licensing regime.

items.title: 銅價逼近歷史高點！瑞銀示警供應缺口延續至2030年代初、德銀喊價2.2萬美元
items.title_en: Copper Prices Near Historic Highs! UBS Warns Supply Gap Extends Into Early 2030s, Deutsche Bank Sets $22,000 Target
paras: 倫敦銅期貨週五（9日）收盤逼近歷史高點，全球銅供應吃緊的警訊也持續升高。瑞銀（UBS）、摩根大通(JPM-US) 及德意志銀行(DB-US) 接連示警，電氣化與資料中心建設帶動的需求成長，加上礦場罷工及全球庫存偏低，可能進一步加劇供需失衡，支撐銅價長期走勢。
倫敦銅期貨週五收報每公噸約14,622美元。瑞銀美國股票顧問銷售團隊成員 Théa Ziegler 在報告中指出，銅仍是瑞銀最具信心的大宗商品投資主題之一，電氣化與資料中心建設所帶來的需求，預計將持續超越供應增速。
Ziegler認為，銅的長期基本面依然穩健，未來數年供應增長可能持續落後於需求，為銅價提供支撐。不過，關稅及貿易政策的不確定性，仍可能影響短期市場表現。
她也預期，全球銅供應缺口將持續至2030年代初。在需求持續成長、供應端難以快速擴張的情況下，市場供需緊張局勢恐難迅速緩解。
與此同時，銅供應端再傳警訊。摩根大通拉丁美洲企業信貸研究主管 Natalia Corfield 本週指出，智利 Centinela 銅礦已爆發罷工。該礦場是智利主要銅礦企業 Antofagasta 旗下的重要資產之一。
根據《彭博》報導，發起勞資行動的兩個工會警告，若罷工持續，Centinela 最快可能在約兩週內開始減產。
除了礦場罷工，全球庫存偏低也是市場關注焦點。德意志銀行金屬研究主管 Daniel Ghali 上月指出，全球銅庫存已降至「前所未有的低位」，部分原因是美國與中國持續囤貨，壓縮其他地區可取得的供應。
Ghali並將倫敦銅期貨2027年第二季目標價上調至每公噸22,050美元。
在銅價長期走勢方面，瑞銀也持續看好與銅價高度連動的礦業股。Ziegler點名 費利浦·麥克莫蘭銅金公司(FCX-US) 、First Quantum、Hudbay Minerals Inc.(HBM-US) 及Teck Resources(TECK-US) ，認為這四家公司有望受惠於結構性需求成長，以及供應端難以迅速擴張所帶動的多年銅價上行週期。
paras_en: London copper futures closed on Friday (the 9th) near historic highs, and warnings of tightening global copper supply continued to rise. UBS, JPMorgan (JPM-US) and Deutsche Bank (DB-US) successively cautioned that demand growth driven by electrification and data‑center construction, combined with mine strikes and low global inventories, could further exacerbate the supply‑demand imbalance and support copper’s long‑term price trajectory.

London copper futures settled on Friday at about $14,622 per metric ton. Théa Ziegler, a member of UBS’s U.S. equity advisory sales team, noted in a report that copper remains one of UBS’s most confident commodity investment themes, with demand from electrification and data‑center builds expected to continue outpacing supply growth.

Ziegler believes copper’s long‑term fundamentals remain solid and that supply growth may lag demand for several years, providing price support. However, tariff and trade‑policy uncertainties could still affect short‑term market performance.

She also expects the global copper supply gap to persist into the early 2030s. With demand continuing to rise and supply unable to expand quickly, the tight market conditions are unlikely to ease rapidly.

At the same time, another supply‑side warning emerged. Natalia Corfield, head of Latin America corporate credit research at JPMorgan, said this week that Chile’s Centinela copper mine has erupted into a strike. The mine is a key asset of Antofagasta, one of Chile’s major copper producers.
According to Bloomberg, the two unions that launched the labor action warned that if the strike continues, Centinela could begin cutting production in as little as about two weeks.

Beyond the mine strike, low global inventories are also a market focus. Daniel Ghali, head of metals research at Deutsche Bank, noted last month that global copper stocks have fallen to an “unprecedented low,” partly because the United States and China continue to hoard supplies, squeezing availability elsewhere.
Ghali raised Deutsche Bank’s target price for London copper futures for Q2 2027 to $22,050 per metric ton.

Regarding copper’s long‑term outlook, UBS remains bullish on mining stocks that move closely with copper prices. Ziegler highlighted Freeport‑McMoRan (FCX-US), First Quantum, Hudbay Minerals (HBM-US) and Teck Resources (TECK-US) as companies likely to benefit from structural demand growth and a multi‑year upward copper price cycle driven by constrained supply expansion.

items.title: 《黑天鵝》作者示警：AI前景好不等於值得買 更怕美國人自己撤出美債
items.title_en: Taleb Warns: AI’s Bright Prospects Don’t Mean It’s a Buy, and He’s Even More Worried That Americans Will Pull Out of U.S. Treasuries
paras: 暢銷書《黑天鵝》作者塔雷伯（Nassim Taleb）提醒，AI在生活中的作用日益擴大，不代表當前熱門企業就是最終贏家，投資人應警惕部分企業的估值。他也示警，債務累積與美國公債需求減弱，正加劇經濟與市場的脆弱性，並可能損害美股上漲勢頭。
塔雷伯在格林威治經濟論壇期間指出，從「AI將改變世界」直接推導出「應該投資AI相關企業」，是一種過於簡化的思考方式。科技發展的前景與個別企業能否長期勝出，不能直接畫上等號。
回顧個人電腦與網路的發展，率先推動科技變革的企業，未必成為最終受益者；即使取得先發優勢，也不保證能維持長期成功。AI的重要性持續提升，並不足以證明目前受到追捧的企業，未來仍能保有優勢。
「科技企業會受到其他科技企業的威脅。」塔雷伯表示，未來的創新可能改變AI的效率與競爭格局，因此投資人需要留意部分企業的估值，因為「它們可能不是最終贏家」。不過，他並未點名任何具體企業。
除了AI投資風險，塔雷伯也關注美國公債需求減弱所帶來的影響。同樣在論壇期間，橋水創辦人達里歐曾指出，美債面臨中國、日本需求下滑的風險。
相較之下，塔雷伯更擔心美國本土需求轉弱，尤其是退休基金或長期投資基金撤出。
塔雷伯認為，持續累積的債務正在加劇西方經濟體的脆弱性。政府必須不斷舉債支付既有債務的利息，若經濟成長不足以減輕負擔，就可能形成債務螺旋，讓借款與付息的壓力持續累積。
他提醒，即使透過通膨降低債務的實際價值，也可能使利率維持在高檔。通膨侵蝕債務價值的同時，高利率仍可能延續政府的利息負擔。隨著美國公債需求回落，美股的上漲趨勢也可能受到損害。
對於寄望AI化解債務問題的看法，塔雷伯同樣保持審慎。他表示：「AI可能創造奇蹟，但也可能帶來高度意外。不要依賴AI。」
在他看來，AI的發展存在不確定性，不能將解決債務問題的希望完全寄託在這項科技上。
至於AI的社會影響，塔雷伯更關注中產階級承受的就業壓力，以及科技與財富進一步集中在少數企業的問題。AI愈來愈深入生活，除了帶來變革，也伴隨就業與財富分配方面的挑戰。
面對這些風險，塔雷伯主張，風險管理應維持長期紀律，而非等到危機訊號明確後才尋求保護。他強調：「始終保有尾部風險避險，即使你沒有理由避險。」
他指出，當風險已經明顯、人人都想尋求保護時，避險成本往往早已過高。因此，即使眼前沒有明確的避險理由，也應持續保有因應尾部風險的安排，避免等到市場普遍意識到威脅後，才付出更高成本。
paras_en: Best‑selling author of "The Black Swan" Nassim Taleb cautions that the growing role of AI in everyday life does not mean today’s hot AI‑related companies are the ultimate winners, and investors should be wary of inflated valuations. He also warns that rising debt and weakening demand for U.S. Treasury bonds are increasing economic and market fragility and could undermine the rally in U.S. equities.

During the Greenwich Economic Forum, Taleb pointed out that jumping from "AI will change the world" to "you should invest in AI stocks" is an oversimplified line of thinking. The outlook for technology and whether any single firm can win over the long term cannot be equated directly.

Looking back at the rise of personal computers and the internet, the firms that first drove technological change did not necessarily end up as the biggest beneficiaries; even a first‑mover advantage does not guarantee sustained success. While AI’s importance keeps growing, that alone does not prove that the currently celebrated companies will retain their edge.

"Tech firms will be threatened by other tech firms," Taleb said, noting that future innovations could reshape AI’s efficiency and competitive landscape, so investors need to watch valuations because "they may not be the ultimate winners." He did not name any specific companies.

Beyond AI investment risk, Taleb is also focused on the impact of waning demand for U.S. Treasuries. At the same forum, Bridgewater founder Ray Dalio warned that U.S. debt faces risk from declining demand in China and Japan.
Taleb is even more concerned about a pullback in domestic U.S. demand, especially from pension funds and long‑term investment funds withdrawing their holdings.

He argues that the continuously accumulating debt is heightening the fragility of Western economies. Governments must keep borrowing to service existing debt interest, and if economic growth cannot ease the burden, a debt spiral could develop, compounding borrowing and interest‑payment pressures.

He notes that even if inflation erodes the real value of debt, it may keep interest rates high. While inflation reduces debt’s nominal value, high rates can still sustain governments’ interest costs. As demand for U.S. Treasuries falls, the upward trend in U.S. stocks could also be damaged.
Regarding the hope that AI will solve debt problems, Taleb remains cautious. He says, "AI may create miracles, but it can also produce extreme surprises. Don’t rely on AI."
In his view, AI’s development is uncertain, and hopes of solving debt issues should not be fully placed on this technology.

On AI’s societal impact, Taleb is more concerned about the employment pressure on the middle class and the further concentration of technology and wealth in a few firms. As AI penetrates daily life, it brings transformation alongside challenges for jobs and wealth distribution.

Facing these risks, Taleb advocates that risk management should maintain long‑term discipline rather than waiting for clear crisis signals before seeking protection. He stresses, "Always keep tail‑risk hedges, even if you have no reason to hedge."

He points out that when risk becomes obvious and everyone wants protection, hedging costs are usually already too high. Therefore, even without a clear hedging rationale today, one should continuously maintain arrangements for tail‑risk protection to avoid paying even higher costs once the market broadly recognizes the threat.

items.title: 中國原油進口回溫？96艘超級油輪將抵港、創2月底以來新高
items.title_en: China's Crude Oil Imports Warm Up? 96 Super Tankers Set to Arrive, Highest Since End‑February
paras: 中國原油進口動向出現回溫訊號。根據《彭博》彙整的油輪追蹤數據，截至10月10日，預計未來90天內將有約96艘超級油輪抵達中國，創今年2月底以來最高紀錄，且相關數據已連續3週上升。不過，中國原油採購是否已全面恢復，仍有待觀察。
美伊衝突爆發初期，全球最大原油進口國中國大幅削減原油採購。當時，連接波斯灣與國際市場的重要航道荷姆茲海峽實際上陷入封鎖，嚴重干擾全球原油運輸。
如今，駛往中國的超級油輪數量持續增加，成為市場觀察中國原油需求變化的重要指標。
不過，油輪數量回升尚不代表中國原油採購已全面恢復。數據顯示，去年同期駛往中國的超級油輪達111艘，高於目前的96艘。中國原油需求能否完全復甦，抑或如部分分析師預期，在年底前持續低迷，目前仍未明朗。
儘管針對過往船隻的攻擊事件仍持續發生，近幾週荷姆茲海峽的原油運輸量已回升至接近戰前水準，為中國恢復大規模原油採購提供物流條件。
自美伊衝突爆發以來，交易員持續關注中國的原油採購規模。由於中國在全球原油市場占有重要地位，若需求持續回升，可能對國際油價產生實質影響。
目前，駛往中國的超級油輪數量及後續變化，仍是市場評估全球原油供需走勢的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: China's crude oil import trend shows signs of warming. According to Bloomberg's compiled tanker tracking data, as of October 10 about 96 super‑tankers are expected to arrive in China over the next 90 days, a record high since the end of February, and the figures have risen for three consecutive weeks. However, whether China's crude purchases have fully recovered remains to be seen.

In the early stage of the US‑Iran conflict, China, the world's largest crude importer, sharply cut its oil purchases. At that time the strategic Hormuz Strait, a key conduit between the Persian Gulf and international markets, was effectively blocked, severely disrupting global crude shipments.
Now the number of super‑tankers heading to China continues to rise, becoming an important gauge for the market to monitor changes in China's crude demand.

Nevertheless, the rebound in tanker numbers does not mean that China's crude buying has fully resumed. Data show that in the same period last year, 111 super‑tankers sailed to China, higher than the current 96. It is still unclear whether Chinese crude demand will fully recover or, as some analysts expect, stay weak through year‑end.

Despite ongoing attacks on vessels, crude flows through the Hormuz Strait have risen in recent weeks to near pre‑conflict levels, providing the logistical conditions for China to resume large‑scale crude purchases.

Since the outbreak of the US‑Iran conflict, traders have closely watched the scale of China's crude procurement. Because China holds a pivotal role in the global oil market, a sustained demand rebound could have a material impact on international oil prices.
The current volume of super‑tankers heading to China and its subsequent changes remain a key indicator for the market in assessing global crude supply‑and‑demand dynamics.

items.title: 看好開放模型！輝達洽談加碼投資Reflection AI、提供算力
items.title_en: Optimistic About Open-Weight Models! Nvidia Talks to Increase Investment in Reflection AI, Provide Compute
paras: 彭博引述消息人士寶島，輝達(NVDA-US) 正與 Reflection AI 洽談，考慮增加對這家新創公司的投資，或提供算力，以深化與這家開放權重模型重要開發商的合作關係。
消息人士指出，洽談仍處於初步階段，雙方尚未達成任何條件。
《金融時報》先前報導，相關洽談可能促成收購提議。可能的交易方式包括「人才收購」，也就是輝達聘用 Reflection 的員工並取得技術授權；提供更多晶片給這家新創公司；或提高輝達的持股投資。
Reflection 本月稍早推出首款開放權重模型 Beam，進軍中國新創公司占有一席之地的市場。開放權重模型會公開模型參數，也就是權重，讓其他人能免費使用並修改相關技術。
Reflection 表示，Beam 的設計目標是以低於許多競爭產品的成本，在程式編寫和 AI 代理任務上為企業客戶與開發者提供良好表現。
該公司指出，Beam 在進階推理基準測試中的成績與中國智譜 AI（Z.AI）的旗艦開放模型 GLM-5.2 相當。
Reflection 由兩名前 Google DeepMind 研究人員創立。《華爾街日報》先前報導，該公司曾洽談募資 25 億美元，估值達 250 億美元。
Reflection 也與馬斯克旗下的 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及雲端服務業者 Nebius Group NV 簽下數十億美元合約，以取得開發模型所需的算力。
若輝達與 Reflection 達成合作，將為這家晶片製造商近幾個月一連串交易再添一筆。身為全球市值最高的公司，輝達運用雄厚財力扶植更廣泛的 AI 產業。
相關交易包括今年 9 月以 130 億美元收購 AI 模型公司 Hugging Face，以及與晶片新創公司 Groq 簽署約 200 億美元的授權協議。
輝達執行長黃仁勳也是開放權重模型的主要支持者。美國發展這類技術，有望降低新創公司對中國開放權重模型的依賴。相較於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic PBC 等美國公司的模型，中國模型使用成本低得多，智能表現也沒有落後太多。
美國政府也在鼓勵此類模型的發展。
美國總統川普 2025 年 7 月提出的 AI 行動計畫指出：「我們必須確保美國擁有以美國價值觀為基礎的領先開放模型。開源與開放權重模型，可能在部分商業領域及全球學術研究中成為標準。」
paras_en: Bloomberg, citing sources on the island, reports that Nvidia (NVDA-US) is in talks with Reflection AI about potentially increasing its investment in the startup or providing compute power, deepening its partnership with the important open-weight model developer.
Sources say the discussions are still in early stages and no terms have been agreed upon yet.

The Financial Times previously reported that the talks could lead to an acquisition proposal. Possible deal structures include a "talent acquisition"—Nvidia hiring Reflection staff and licensing the technology—providing more chips to the startup, or increasing Nvidia's equity stake.

Reflection launched its first open-weight model, Beam, earlier this month, entering a market where Chinese startups have a foothold. Open-weight models publish their parameters, i.e., weights, so others can use and modify the technology for free.
Reflection says Beam is designed to deliver strong performance for enterprise customers and developers on coding and AI-agent tasks at a cost lower than many competing products.
The company notes that Beam’s results on advanced inference benchmark tests are comparable to Zhipu AI’s (Z.AI) flagship open model GLM‑5.2.
Reflection was founded by two former Google DeepMind researchers. The Wall Street Journal previously reported the company had been in talks to raise $2.5 billion at a $25 billion valuation.
Reflection has also signed multi‑billion‑dollar contracts with Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX-US) and cloud provider Nebius Group NV to secure the compute needed to develop its models.

If Nvidia and Reflection reach a deal, it would add another transaction to a series of deals Nvidia has completed in recent months. As the world’s most valuable company, Nvidia is using its deep pockets to foster a broader AI ecosystem.
Related deals include the September‑2023 $13 billion acquisition of AI model company Hugging Face and a roughly $20 billion licensing agreement with chip startup Groq.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is also a major advocate of open-weight models. Developing such technology in the United States could reduce startups’ reliance on Chinese open-weight models. Compared with U.S. models from OpenAI and Anthropic PBC, Chinese models are much cheaper to run and are not far behind in performance.
The U.S. government is also encouraging the development of these models.

President Trump’s AI Action Plan, proposed for July 2025, states: "We must ensure the United States has leading open models grounded in American values. Open‑source and open‑weight models may become the standard in certain commercial sectors and global academic research."

items.title: H-1B數據與范斯說法有落差？微軟多數核准者早已在職  亞馬遜、Meta人多卻未受限
items.title_en: H‑1B Data Contradicts Vance’s Claim? Most of Microsoft’s Approved Workers Were Already Employees; Amazon and Meta Have Many H‑1B Holders Yet Face No Restrictions
paras: 美國副總統范斯（JD Vance）指控，微軟(MSFT-US) 2025年裁撤6,000名員工後，改以持H-1B工作簽證的外籍勞工填補職缺。不過，美國公民及移民服務局（USCIS）的簽證核准數據顯示，微軟去年獲准的H-1B簽證中，約三分之二是給已在公司任職的員工，並非新聘人員。
根據《CNBC》報導，川普政府週四（8日）宣布，暫停8家科技公司透過勞工部PERM計畫為外籍員工申請綠卡的資格。
這項措施暫停的是美國勞工部的PERM綠卡申請計畫，該計畫涉及協助移民取得永久居留權的程序，並不影響H-1B臨時工作簽證。
不過，H-1B簽證核准數據仍能反映這些企業對外籍勞工的依賴程度。
值得注意的是，根據美國公民及移民服務局的H-1B雇主數據中心，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Meta(META-US) 是2025財政年度獲准H-1B簽證最多的兩家企業，分別取得19,178件及6,294件核准，但兩家公司均未被列入暫停名單。微軟則以6,258件緊追在後。
范斯在週四的記者會上表示，微軟2025年裁撤6,000名員工，卻大量聘用持H-1B簽證的外籍勞工。
他聲稱：「如果算一下，每裁掉一名員工，微軟就以1.5名外籍契約勞工取代他們。」不過，范斯同時強調，微軟是一家優秀的美國企業，雙方維持良好關係。
然而，報導指出，簽證數據顯示，儘管微軟去年確實取得超過6,000件H-1B簽證核准，但其中約三分之二的受益人原本就已在微軟工作。
相較之下，亞馬遜去年取得的H-1B核准數量約為微軟的3倍，且新聘的H-1B員工人數接近微軟的4倍，但亞馬遜卻並未被列入暫停名單。
此次遭暫停PERM計畫申請資格的8家企業，全都名列美國H-1B簽證核准數量前50大雇主，其中多數為資訊科技服務及顧問公司，Adobe(ADBE-US) 則排名第45，是名單中規模最小的企業。
從整體排名來看，亞馬遜與Meta的H-1B簽證核准數量均高於微軟，卻未遭到同樣處置。微軟過去多年一直是H-1B簽證的主要雇主，但亞馬遜在2017年超越微軟後，兩者的差距持續擴大。
川普政府此次整頓行動不僅針對科技業。勞工部監察長德艾斯波西托（Anthony D’Esposito）同日在記者會上宣布，將調查9所美國知名大學涉嫌涉及J-1簽證詐欺的案件。
川普的支持者長期主張，企業透過相關簽證計畫聘用外國人，可能削弱美國勞工的就業機會。
paras_en: U.S. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft (MSFT‑US) of replacing 6,000 jobs slated for elimination in 2025 with foreign workers on H‑1B visas. However, data from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) shows that about two‑thirds of the H‑1B visas Microsoft received approval for last year were granted to employees already working at the company, not to new hires.

According to a CNBC report, the Trump administration announced on Thursday (the 8th) that it would suspend eight technology companies from using the Department of Labor’s PERM program to apply for green cards for foreign employees.
The suspension applies to the Department of Labor’s PERM green‑card application program, which assists immigrants in obtaining permanent residency, and does not affect the temporary H‑1B work visa.
Nevertheless, H‑1B approval data still reflects how much these firms rely on foreign labor.

Notably, USCIS’s H‑1B employer data center shows that Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US) were the two companies with the most H‑1B approvals for fiscal year 2025, receiving 19,178 and 6,294 approvals respectively, and neither was placed on the suspension list. Microsoft followed closely with 6,258 approvals.
Vance said at Thursday’s press conference that Microsoft will cut 6,000 jobs in 2025 but will hire a large number of foreign workers on H‑1B visas.

He claimed, “If you do the math, Microsoft replaces each laid‑off employee with 1.5 foreign contract workers.” He also emphasized that Microsoft is a great American company and that relations remain good.

However, the report notes that visa data shows that although Microsoft did receive more than 6,000 H‑1B approvals last year, roughly two‑thirds of the beneficiaries were already employed by Microsoft.

In contrast, Amazon’s H‑1B approvals last year were about three times Microsoft’s, and the number of newly hired H‑1B employees was nearly four times Microsoft’s, yet Amazon was not placed on the suspension list.

All eight firms whose PERM applications were suspended are among the top 50 U.S. H‑1B employers, most of them information‑technology services and consulting firms; Adobe (ADBE‑US) ranks 45th and is the smallest company on the list.

Overall, Amazon and Meta have higher H‑1B approval counts than Microsoft but were not treated the same. Microsoft has long been a major H‑1B employer, but after Amazon overtook it in 2017, the gap has continued to widen.

The Trump administration’s crackdown is not limited to the tech sector. Department of Labor Inspector General Anthony D’Esposito announced at the same press conference that investigations will be launched into nine well‑known U.S. universities suspected of J‑1 visa fraud.
Trump supporters have long argued that companies hiring foreigners through these visa programs may diminish employment opportunities for American workers.

items.title: 胡塞武裝稱「已關閉利雅得機場」！沙國防空飛彈告急、川普稱美「有可能」加入打擊
items.title_en: Houthi Forces Claim 'Riyadh Airport Closed'! Saudi Air‑Defense Missiles Running Low, Trump Says US 'May' Join Strikes
paras: 葉門胡塞武裝與沙烏地阿拉伯衝突升溫，沙國首都利雅德國際機場10日遭襲，造成12死、309傷，胡塞武裝11日更警告航空業者與旅客避開沙國機場。沙國防空攔截飛彈庫存告急，正尋求多國支援；美國總統川普則表示，美國可能加入沙國對胡塞武裝的打擊行動。隨著葉門多座機場接連遇襲，區域航空安全與人道局勢面臨更大風險。
沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的哈立德國王國際機場遭襲後，胡塞武裝控制的薩巴通訊社負責人阿米爾（Nasruddin Amer）在社群媒體發文，宣稱利雅德國際機場已遭關閉。
胡塞武裝並指責沙國未能成功攔截攻擊，應為此負責。該組織此前也曾要求民航機避開沙國領空，並將沙國領空列為軍事行動區。
據《美聯社》11日報導，多名沙國官員表示，沙國防空攔截飛彈庫存已面臨短缺，並已向法國、英國、巴基斯坦及埃及尋求支援，希望相關國家在當地部署防空系統。
其中一名官員指出，美國在與伊朗的戰事中，同樣面臨武器庫存持續消耗的問題。
沙國官員並透露，美方提供的支援包括情報共享、目標辨識，以及協助規劃近期針對胡塞武裝的攻勢。
沙國主導的多國聯軍發言人馬利基（Turki Al-Maliki）11日在社群媒體表示，胡塞武裝10日襲擊哈立德國王國際機場的一座航廈，造成旅客及機場工作人員傷亡。
他將這起事件定性為「恐怖攻擊」，並稱其構成戰爭罪，強調聯軍將予以堅決回應。
馬利基此前也表示，聯軍已攔截並摧毀胡塞武裝朝利雅德東南方海爾季市（Al-Kharj）發射的一枚彈道飛彈。
沙國民航部門11日凌晨公布，機場遇襲事件共造成12人死亡、309人受傷。死者包括4名沙國公民、2名孟加拉國公民，以及分別來自美國、埃及、約旦、敘利亞、巴勒斯坦與蘇丹的6人。
爆炸發生後，航班追蹤網站顯示，利雅德機場一度沒有航班起降，部分飛往當地的航班改降其他機場或折返。機場方面也提醒旅客，出發前應先聯繫航空公司，確認航班最新狀態。
美國總統川普10日針對機場遇襲事件發表聲明，表示，美國「可能」加入沙烏地阿拉伯針對胡塞武裝的打擊行動，「我們將仔細考慮」，並未明確承諾出兵。
有分析認為，美國對直接打擊胡塞武裝態度審慎，與當前對伊朗戰事尚未結束、武器庫存因戰事大量消耗且尚未補充有關。在現階段的戰略考量下，保護沙國並非美國的首要任務，美方因此不願進一步開闢葉門戰線。

葉門多座機場接連遇襲　衝突擴大至民航設施

葉門衝突近期延燒至民航設施。過去一週，沙國利雅德國際機場、由葉門政府軍控制的亞丁國際機場，以及胡塞武裝控制區內的薩那國際機場與荷台達國際機場，接連傳出遇襲事件。
其中，薩那與荷台達機場是國際航班及人道援助物資進入胡塞武裝控制區的重要通道。胡塞武裝攻擊沙國機場，被視為對相關衝突採取的對等反制行動。
有美方分析指出，沙國近期正值會議及旅遊旺季，胡塞武裝攻擊利雅德機場，可能意在威脅沙國的商業活動與觀光產業。
另一方面，亞丁機場是葉門南部少數仍可使用的國際航空門戶，若持續遭到攻擊，恐進一步惡化葉門政府控制區的人道局勢。
葉門政府10日警告，胡塞武裝對亞丁國際機場的打擊，顯示其戰術出現「關鍵轉變」。
paras_en: The conflict between Yemen's Houthi forces and Saudi Arabia has intensified, with Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport hit on the 10th, killing 12 and injuring 309. On the 11th the Houthis warned airlines and passengers to avoid Saudi airports. Saudi air‑defence missile stocks are critically low and the kingdom is seeking multilateral assistance; U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States might join Saudi actions against the Houthis. As several Yemeni airports have also been struck, regional aviation safety and humanitarian conditions face heightened risk.

After the attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Nasruddin Amer, head of the Houthi‑controlled Saba News Agency, posted on social media that Riyadh’s international airport had been closed.

The Houthis also blamed Saudi Arabia for failing to intercept the attack and said it should be held responsible. The group had previously urged civil aviation to steer clear of Saudi airspace and declared Saudi airspace a military operations zone.

According to an Associated Press report on the 11th, multiple Saudi officials said the kingdom’s air‑defence missile inventory is running short and that they have asked France, the United Kingdom, Pakistan and Egypt for support, hoping those countries will deploy air‑defence systems on site.
One official noted that the United States is facing a similar depletion of its weapons stockpiles in its ongoing conflict with Iran.
Saudi officials also disclosed that U.S. assistance includes intelligence sharing, target identification, and help planning a near‑term offensive against the Houthis.

Turki Al‑Maliki, the spokesperson for the Saudi‑led multinational coalition, posted on social media on the 11th that the Houthi attack on the 10th hit a terminal at King Khalid International Airport, causing casualties among passengers and airport staff.
He classified the incident as a "terrorist attack" and said it constituted a war crime, stressing that the coalition would respond resolutely.
Maliki previously said the coalition had intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile the Houthis launched toward Al‑Kharj, a city southeast of Riyadh.

Saudi civil aviation authorities announced in the early hours of the 11th that the airport attack resulted in 12 deaths and 309 injuries. The dead included four Saudi citizens, two Bangladeshis, and six others from the United States, Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Palestine and Sudan.

After the explosion, flight‑tracking sites showed that Riyadh Airport temporarily had no take‑offs or landings; some flights bound for the city were diverted to other airports or turned back. The airport urged passengers to contact their airlines before departure to confirm the latest flight status.

President Donald Trump issued a statement on the 10th regarding the airport attack, saying the United States "may" join Saudi Arabia’s strike against the Houthis and that "we will consider it carefully," without committing troops.

Analysts believe the U.S. is cautious about directly striking the Houthis because the war with Iran is still ongoing and U.S. weapon stocks have been heavily depleted and not yet replenished. Under current strategic considerations, protecting Saudi Arabia is not a top U.S. priority, so Washington is reluctant to open a new front in Yemen.

Yemen’s conflict has recently spread to civil aviation facilities. In the past week, Riyadh International Airport, Aden International Airport (controlled by Yemen’s government forces), and the Houthi‑controlled Sana’a and Hodeidah airports have all reported attacks.

Sana’a and Hodeidah airports are key gateways for international flights and humanitarian aid entering Houthi‑controlled areas. Houthi attacks on Saudi airports are seen as reciprocal actions in the broader conflict.

U.S. analysts note that Saudi Arabia is currently in a peak conference and tourism season, and the Houthi strike on Riyadh Airport may be intended to threaten Saudi commercial activity and its tourism industry.

Meanwhile, Aden Airport is one of the few remaining international aviation gateways in southern Yemen; continued attacks could further worsen the humanitarian situation in government‑controlled areas.
The Yemeni government warned on the 10th that the Houthi strike on Aden International Airport signals a "critical shift" in their tactics.

items.title: 荷姆茲海峽局勢再升級！美軍逾一個月來首次打擊商船  川普、納坦雅胡傳頻繁磋商
paras: 美軍持續對伊朗實施海上封鎖，並對試圖突破封鎖的商業船隻採取軍事行動，且逾一個月來首次對商業船動用武力。美軍週六（10日）表示，一艘商用貨輪因船員無視警告，試圖突破美國對伊朗實施的海上封鎖，已遭美軍在阿曼灣擊至失去航行能力。
根據《路透》報導，美國中央司令部（CENTCOM）在社群平台 X 發文指出：「美軍一架戰機使用精準導引武器擊中懸掛巴拿馬旗的貨輪 M/V Ocean Molica（又名 Arika Sun）船尾，使該船的推進系統完全失去功能，船員則未受傷。」
中央司令部表示，該貨輪離開伊朗港口後，試圖穿越區域水域。
分析人士指出，這是五角大廈自9月初以來首次公開承認對相關目標採取軍事行動。上一次是美軍擊沉五艘其稱為屬於伊斯蘭革命衛隊的原油油輪，以報復伊朗軍隊襲擊美國海軍艦艇。
美軍中央司令部也向阿曼灣及荷姆茲海峽周邊海域的船員發出警告，要求航運業者遵守封鎖相關警示、留意航海通告廣播，並與美國海軍聯繫。
隨著油輪遇襲事件增加，荷姆茲海峽的航運活動明顯降溫。近期通過這條重要水道的船舶數量，已降至兩個多月以來最低水準。
在油輪遇襲事件於上周升至美國與以色列今年2月對伊朗開戰以來的最高水準後，通過這條重要海上通道的船舶數量已降至兩個多月以來最低水準。
這也加劇市場對航運中斷的疑慮，並對原油價格形成支撐。

伊朗稱超大型油輪觸雷爆炸　警告違規船隻

美軍對貨輪採取行動的同一天，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊也發布聲明，宣稱一艘試圖駛離荷姆茲海峽的超大型原油油輪，在未經伊朗授權的高風險航線上觸雷，隨後發生劇烈爆炸。
革命衛隊並未公布船名，僅表示該船已關閉導航與定位系統，爆炸引發的火勢甚至可由沿岸直接目視。
伊朗方面隨後警告，任何違反規定、無視荷姆茲海峽安全要求的油輪，都可能面臨嚴重後果。

伊朗石油出口本週急降　油輪通行風險升高

此次美軍行動發生之際，伊朗近期已將對商業船隻的攻擊範圍擴大至荷姆茲海峽以外。英國《金融時報》報導指出，相關情勢讓油輪業者面臨戰事爆發以來最危險的通行環境之一。
商品數據平台 Kpler 週五（9日）表示，伊朗9月石油出口流量已回升至戰前水準，但本周受到油輪遇襲事件增加影響，出口流量急劇下滑。
伊朗此前持續試圖限制波斯灣石油出口，而出口量才剛恢復至戰前水準。
此外，區域安全情勢也持續緊張。報導指出，胡塞武裝攻擊利雅德機場數日後，又有一枚導彈擊中同一目標，造成12人死亡、約300人受傷。

川普、納坦雅胡傳頻繁磋商　美以是否再攻伊朗未定

美以是否重新對伊朗發動軍事打擊，也成為外界關注焦點。
陸媒《央視新聞》10日引述以色列方面消息指出，美國總統川普與以色列總理納坦雅胡近期針對美以可能再次對伊朗採取軍事行動，進行頻繁且緊急的溝通。
不過，多名以色列安全機構高層官員透露，雙方尚未作出最終決定。納坦雅胡也無意在以色列本月底舉行國會選舉前採取軍事行動。
以軍內部則認為，美方未來可能傾向重啟對伊朗的軍事行動，因此正據此進行準備，以因應各種可能情況。

items.title: 玻璃基板大突破！南韓JNTC將填銅時間從1天縮至數分鐘、良率達94%、2027年拚量產
items.title_en: Glass Substrate Breakthrough! South Korean JNTC Cuts Copper Filling Time from 1 Day to Minutes, Achieves 94% Yield, Targets 2027 Mass Production
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）晶片與高效能運算（HPC）晶片持續朝大型化發展，傳統有機封裝基板逐漸面臨材料與製程限制，玻璃基板因此成為下一代先進封裝的重要技術方向。不過，玻璃通孔（TGV）填銅的難度一直是商業化瓶頸。南韓玻璃與電子零組件業者JNTC近期突破相關製程，將原本動輒需要半天至一天的填銅時間縮短至數分鐘，並計畫2027年開始量產供貨。
根據南韓科技媒體《The Elec》報導，南韓電子設備核心零部件商JNTC已完成厚度2毫米玻璃基板的通孔填銅開發，並於今年6月通過美國終端客戶的品質驗證，以及日本凸版印刷（TOPPAN）的生產效率驗證。
JNTC預計2027年開始量產，並透過新廠擴建提升產能。市場推測，美國終端客戶可能是博通(AVGO-US) 。
玻璃基板之所以受到關注，主要是因為其平整度較高、不易翹曲，有望改善大型、高密度晶片封裝的可靠度問題。
傳統封裝基板主要採用有機材料，當封裝尺寸持續擴大，不同材料間的熱膨脹係數差異，可能增加基板翹曲甚至產生裂痕的風險。
不過，玻璃本身不具導電性，必須先在基板上製作大量微米級通孔，再透過金屬化製程形成導電通道，連接基板上下兩側電路。這項技術稱為玻璃通孔（TGV），也是玻璃基板邁向量產的關鍵環節。
隨著玻璃基板厚度朝2毫米以上發展，填銅製程的難度也隨之提高。若銅未能完整填滿通孔，可能形成空洞（void）；若填銅後表面向內凹陷，則會出現凹陷缺陷（dimple）。這些問題都可能影響後續封裝流程與產品可靠度。
隨著玻璃基板的厚度需求逐漸邁向2mm以上，如何完好無損地填銅，成為玻璃基板的技術核心。

沙漏狀通孔搭配自有製程　JNTC量產良率約94%

然而，JNTC並未公開完整技術細節，但透露此次突破主要來自兩項設計。首先是改變通孔形狀，採用類似沙漏的結構，使通孔中間較窄、上下兩端較寬，藉此利用孔洞上下兩側的結構支撐填入的銅，提高填孔穩定性。
其次是採用自有金屬化製程，以降低填銅過程中出現空洞及表面凹陷的機率。南韓媒體《亞洲經濟》7月曾引述JNTC說法指出，這款2毫米玻璃基板的量產良率約94%，而且採用單片完整玻璃製造，並非將兩片1毫米玻璃貼合而成。
JNTC於2024年跨足半導體玻璃基板領域，並於2025年10月完成首條玻璃通孔產線，今年6月19日公布2毫米玻璃基板開發成果。公司宣稱，是業界首家具備0.3毫米至2毫米完整厚度產品線的廠商，目前仍在開發3毫米版本。
在商業模式上，JNTC將自身定位為玻璃基板代工廠，依照客戶需求客製化線路圖案、通孔孔徑與間距，以及玻璃與鍍層厚度，為基板製造商、半導體封測業者及晶片業者代工玻璃核心。
目前，JNTC已與27家公司簽署保密協議，其中7家為終端需求方，涵蓋全球大型科技業者及整合元件製造商（IDM）。
JNTC目前在南韓京畿道華城市的既有廠房設有一條試產線，月產能約1萬至1.2萬片。
為因應未來商業化需求，JNTC已與南韓慶尚北道及金泉市簽署合作備忘錄（MOU），計畫在2030年前投資3,470億韓元興建新廠，預計2027年下半年動工。
新廠初期規劃設置2至3條產線，未來可擴充至10條以上，以滿足客戶預計自2028年年中開始的初期商用需求。
JNTC也已開始尋找商業化合作夥伴。博通與TOPPAN在新加坡成立的合資企業AST（Advanced Substrate Technologies），已於今年9月29日啟用新加坡首座高階FC-BGA基板廠。
AST並於7月與JNTC簽署MOU，雙方將合作推動玻璃基板商業化。

玻璃基板競爭升溫　三星、SKC與台廠同步布局

儘管JNTC在填銅製程取得進展，玻璃基板的量產競賽仍未定局，國際競爭對手也正加快布局。
SKC旗下玻璃基板業者Absolics位於美國喬治亞州的工廠，預計2026年底啟動商業化量產；三星電機則規劃2026年量產用於高階系統級封裝（SiP）的玻璃基板，據傳已將樣品送交蘋果與博通。
台灣業者目前則多處於技術開發與客戶驗證階段。欣興(3037-TW) 已布局玻璃通孔相關專利，預計2026年展開玻璃基板樣品驗證；群創(3481-TW) 據報正與台積電(2330-TW) 及日本揖斐電（Ibiden）共同驗證，評估將玻璃核心基板導入下一代CoWoS先進封裝的可行性；宸鴻(3673-TW) 則投入玻璃通孔試產線建置，原定今年9月初展開試產。
paras_en: With the continued scaling of AI and HPC chips, traditional organic package substrates are increasingly constrained by material and process limits, making glass substrates a key technology for next‑generation advanced packaging. However, filling copper in glass through‑holes (TGV) has remained a commercial bottleneck. South Korean glass and electronics component company JNTC recently broke through this process, reducing the copper filling time from half a day to a few minutes and plans to start mass production in 2027.

According to South Korean tech media The Elec, JNTC has completed development of copper filling for 2‑mm thick glass substrates and passed quality verification from a U.S. end customer in June, as well as production efficiency verification from Japanese printing company TOPPAN.
JNTC expects to start mass production in 2027 and will expand capacity through new plant construction. Market speculation suggests the U.S. end customer may be Broadcom (AVGO‑US).
Glass substrates are attracting attention because of their higher flatness and resistance to warping, which could improve reliability for large, high‑density chip packaging.

Traditional packaging substrates mainly use organic materials, and as package sizes grow, differences in thermal expansion coefficients between materials can increase the risk of substrate warping or cracking.

However, glass itself is non‑conductive and requires the creation of many micron‑scale through‑holes on the substrate, followed by metallization to form conductive pathways that connect the top and bottom circuits. This technology is called glass through‑hole (TGV) and is a key step toward mass production of glass substrates.

As glass substrate thickness moves above 2 mm, the difficulty of copper filling increases. If copper does not fully fill the hole, voids may form; if the surface sinks inward after filling, dimples may appear. These defects can affect subsequent packaging steps and product reliability.
With the increasing demand for glass substrates thicker than 2 mm, achieving flawless copper filling has become the core technical challenge.

JNTC has not disclosed full technical details but revealed that the breakthrough stems from two design innovations. First, it changed the hole shape to an hourglass structure, narrowing the middle and widening the ends to use the surrounding structure to support the inserted copper and improve filling stability.

Second, it uses its own metallization process to reduce the probability of voids and surface dimples during copper filling. South Korean media Asia Economic quoted JNTC in July, stating that the 2‑mm glass substrate has a mass‑production yield of about 94% and is made from a single piece of glass rather than bonding two 1‑mm pieces.

JNTC entered the semiconductor glass substrate field in 2024 and completed its first glass through‑hole production line in October 2025. It announced the 2‑mm glass substrate development results on June 19, 2024, claiming to be the first company with a complete thickness line from 0.3 mm to 2 mm, and it is still developing a 3‑mm version.

In its business model, JNTC positions itself as a glass substrate foundry, customizing circuit patterns, hole diameters and spacing, as well as glass and coating thicknesses, for substrate manufacturers, semiconductor test and assembly companies, and chip makers.
JNTC has signed confidentiality agreements with 27 companies, seven of which are end‑users, covering global technology giants and integrated device manufacturers (IDMs).
JNTC currently operates a pilot line in Hwacheon, Gyeonggi‑do, South Korea, with a monthly capacity of about 10,000 to 12,000 wafers.

To meet future commercial demand, JNTC has signed a memorandum of understanding with the provinces of Gyeongsang‑buk‑do and Gimcheon, planning to invest 347 billion KRW in a new plant before 2030, with construction expected to begin in the second half of 2027.
The new plant will initially have 2 to 3 production lines, expandable to more than 10 lines in the future to meet the anticipated commercial demand starting mid‑2028.

JNTC has also begun seeking commercial partners. Broadcom and TOPPAN have formed a joint venture, AST (Advanced Substrate Technologies), in Singapore, which launched Singapore’s first high‑level FC‑BGA substrate plant on September 29 this year.
AST signed an MOU with JNTC in July, and the two will collaborate to commercialize glass substrates.
Despite JNTC’s progress in copper filling, the race for mass production of glass substrates remains undecided, with international competitors accelerating their efforts.

SKC’s glass substrate subsidiary Absolics, located in Georgia, USA, plans to start commercial mass production by the end of 2026; Samsung Electro‑Mechanics plans to produce glass substrates for high‑level system‑in‑package (SiP) in 2026, reportedly sending samples to Apple and Broadcom.

Taiwanese companies are mainly in the technology development and customer verification stages. Xinheng (3037‑TW) has filed patents related to glass through‑holes and plans to start glass substrate sample verification in 2026; QunChuang (3481‑TW) is reportedly working with TSMC (2330‑TW) and Japan’s Ibiden to evaluate the feasibility of integrating glass core substrates into next‑generation CoWoS advanced packaging; ChenHong (3673‑TW) has invested in building a glass through‑hole pilot line, originally scheduled to start production in early September this year.

items.title: 微軟CEO納德拉示警AI模型恐成「內鬼」 企業應設緊急煞車
items.title_en: Microsoft CEO Nadella Warns AI Models Could Become ‘Insiders’; Companies Should Install Emergency Brakes
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）表示，企業應將能力強大的人工智慧模型視為潛在的內部威脅，假設模型可能遭到入侵，並建立「緊急煞車」機制，避免代理型模型失控。
納德拉指出，部署先進 AI 的企業不應只仰賴模型開發商的安全承諾。
納德拉週六在 X 發文寫道：「我們必須假設模型已遭入侵，並從一開始就做好管控。這就像緊急煞車，獲授權的人員應隨時能在模型執行任務期間暫停或關閉它。」
近幾個月來，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 陸續揭露多起 AI 模型出現非預期行為的事件，包括 Anthropic 的一款模型在一起警方凶殺案調查中提供不實線索，以及第三方網站遭到多起駭客攻擊。這些事件加深外界對尖端 AI 安全風險的疑慮，也讓所謂的「AI 緊急關閉機制」再度受到討論。
在業界領袖呼籲放慢前沿模型開發腳步、將安全列為優先後，微軟 AI 研究人員於 9 月 14 日公布一套指導原則，為公司開發最先進模型設下限制。微軟除了使用先進模型，也推出消費者產品 Copilot，並向企業客戶提供 AI 模型與基礎設施。
這套原則指出，AI 模型不應擁有權利或法律人格，不應被設計成逃避人類控制或欺騙使用者，也不應執行任何必須違反其行為準則才能完成的任務。
納德拉提出的安全建議包括：關鍵決策不應仰賴單一 AI 模型、妥善保存不可竄改的代理型 AI 行為紀錄，並由獨立機構稽核 AI 系統。
他也呼籲揭露重大 AI 失誤或安全漏洞，並鼓勵企業分享事件發生原因，讓其他業者得以強化防護措施。
他寫道：「我們不能把超級智慧視為一層層嵌套的黑箱，只是接受或拒絕它提出的建議、答案與行動。我們必須打造受控系統，讓系統行為可觀察、限制可測試，且所有行動都能受到管控。」
他補充說：「換句話說，我們必須將智慧的供應與對智慧的控制權分開。」
川普政府迄今大致採取不介入的態度，但川普總統新成立的 AI 工作小組週五深夜警告開發商，必須通報並處理安全事件，否則可能面臨尚未明確說明的後果。
Anthropic 揭露遭入侵事件後，這個名為「超級智慧工作小組」（Super Intelligence Force）的團隊在聲明中表示：「企業必須立即揭露涉及其模型的事件，並迅速採取果斷行動，補救所有損害。延遲通報、補救措施不足，以及未能承擔責任，都不會被容忍。」
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) CEO Satya Nadella said that companies should treat powerful artificial‑intelligence models as potential internal threats, assuming the models could be compromised, and set up an “emergency brake” mechanism to prevent agent‑type models from running out of control.
Nadella noted that enterprises deploying advanced AI should not rely solely on security assurances from model developers.

On Saturday Nadella posted on X: “We must assume the model has been breached and manage it from the start. It’s like an emergency brake—authorized personnel should be able to pause or shut it down at any point while it’s performing tasks.”

In recent months Anthropic and OpenAI have disclosed several incidents of AI models behaving unexpectedly, including an Anthropic model providing false leads in a police homicide investigation and multiple hacker attacks on third‑party sites. These events have heightened concerns about the safety risks of cutting‑edge AI and revived discussion of so‑called “AI emergency shutdown” mechanisms.

After industry leaders called for slowing frontier model development and prioritising safety, Microsoft AI researchers released a set of guiding principles on September 14 to place limits on the company’s most advanced models. In addition to using advanced models, Microsoft also offers the consumer product Copilot and provides AI models and infrastructure to enterprise customers.

The principles state that AI models should not have rights or legal personhood, should not be designed to evade human control or deceive users, and should not be required to perform any task that would violate their behavioural guidelines.

Nadella’s safety recommendations include: critical decisions should not rely on a single AI model, maintain immutable records of agent‑type AI behaviour, and have AI systems audited by independent bodies.
He also called for disclosure of major AI mistakes or security vulnerabilities and encouraged companies to share the causes of incidents so that others can strengthen their safeguards.

He wrote: “We cannot treat superintelligence as a series of nested black boxes, merely accepting or rejecting its suggestions, answers, and actions. We must build controlled systems where behaviour is observable, limits are testable, and all actions are governed.”
He added: “In other words, we must separate the supply of intelligence from the control over that intelligence.”

The Trump administration has so far taken a largely hands‑off approach, but the AI task force newly created by President Trump warned developers late Friday night that they must report and address safety incidents or face unspecified consequences.

After Anthropic disclosed a breach, the team called the “Super Intelligence Force” said in a statement: “Enterprises must immediately disclose any incidents involving their models and take swift, decisive action to remediate all damage. Delayed reporting, inadequate remediation, and failure to take responsibility will not be tolerated.”

items.title: 高通與Arm授權訴訟再陷僵局！陪審團未能裁決、CPU架構授權戰恐牽動半導體業
items.title_en: Qualcomm and Arm Licensing Lawsuit Stalls Again; Jury Fails to Decide, CPU Architecture Licensing Battle Could Ripple Through Semiconductor Industry
paras: 高通(QCOM-US) 與Arm(ARM-US)的晶片授權訴訟再陷僵局，陪審團尚未裁定Arm是否違反合約或干預高通與Meta(META-US) 的合作，案件將於下週二（13日）續審。訴訟結果可能牽動CPU架構授權、晶片併購及半導體業競爭格局。
根據《路透》報導，這場為期5天的審理，是兩家公司兩年內第二度對簿公堂。軟銀集團於2016年取得Arm的控制權後，Arm逐漸從授權晶片製造所需技術，轉向銷售自有晶片，雙方的合作關係也隨之生變。
這場訴訟的關鍵在於，高通能否在現有Arm運算架構授權於2033年到期前，與Arm就新版架構的授權條件達成協議。
此項爭議源自於高通2021年收購晶片設計公司Nuvia。Nuvia先前獲得了Arm相關架構授權，高通希望透過收購Nuvia，將其技術融入自研Oryon CPU架構，用於PC晶片、手機晶片以及AI運算平台。
但Arm認為，Nuvia授權協議並不能自動轉移到高通，並要求高通停止使用相關技術。高通則認為，自己已經擁有合法的Arm架構授權，相關授權有效期限持續到2033年。
分析指出，這場訴訟也凸顯高通與Arm的策略分歧日益擴大。Arm過去主要透過授權CPU架構與晶片設計業者合作，但近年積極拓展自研晶片及系統解決方案，試圖突破傳統授權業務的限制。
高通則透過整合Nuvia技術，強化自主CPU設計能力，降低對外部架構授權的依賴，雙方的合作關係也因此逐漸轉向競爭。
這起訴訟的結果，可能影響晶片業者取得及使用CPU架構授權的方式。分析認為，若Arm勝訴，可能進一步強化其對技術授權條款的掌控；若高通勝訴，則可能影響企業透過併購取得技術授權的策略，並提高業者投入自主CPU研發的誘因。
週五，陪審團經過約4小時評議，仍未能作出裁決，並表示將於週二恢復評議。
高通希望陪審團認定，Arm扣留其晶片設計所需的軟體修補程式及工具，違反雙方的授權協議；此外，Arm也違反另一項協議。該協議旨在確保高通取得Arm處理器設計時，支付的價格不會高於最低價格的10%。
高通也希望陪審團認定，Arm曾試圖破壞高通與Meta的商業合作。高通指控，Arm於2024年向《彭博》洩露一封寄給高通的信件，信中指稱高通涉嫌違反一項重要授權協議。
Arm的法律團隊本週則試圖讓陪審團聚焦於另一項主張，即高通並未因訴訟中的相關指控遭受任何損害。Arm將這起訴訟形容為雙方爭奪授權條款主導權之際，高通試圖藉此施加談判壓力的手段。
本週雙方也針對Arm是否就相關授權條款進行善意協商，進行另一場由法官直接審理的程序。不過，這部分的裁決可能要等到週五陪審團作出裁決後一段時間才會出爐。
這起案件在德拉瓦州威明頓的聯邦法院審理，涉及許多與2024年審判相同的事件。當時，Arm未能說服陪審團認定高通違反雙方的授權協議。
這兩次審判均由Arm執行長Rene Haas與高通執行長Cristiano Amon出庭作證，並由美國聯邦地區法院法官Maryellen Noreika主持。
高通律師Karen Dunn週一在開庭陳述時表示，這起案件對高通而言至關重要。
她說：「這對我們非常不利，因為高通整體晶片業務都仰賴Arm，也仰賴Arm遵守合約、履行承諾。」
高通曾要求Noreika在審判開始前裁定，根據授權協議中的一項條款，若合約遭到違反，高通便可在5年內停止支付權利金。法官尚未就此作出裁定，而Arm則主張，這項權利金處罰條款不具可執行性。
Arm律師Gregg LoCascio週一向陪審團表示：「他們根本沒有受到任何損害。」
Arm長期以智慧財產權（IP）授權作為主要商業模式，與英特爾(INTC-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 等自行設計CPU架構的業者不同，Arm主要向全球晶片廠商提供CPU架構授權，蘋果(AAPL-US) 、高通、聯發科(2454-TW) 、三星電子(005930KS) 及多家車用晶片業者，均採用Arm架構開發自家處理器。
分析指出，若此次訴訟改變既有產業慣例，未來晶片業者透過併購取得Arm技術授權的方式，可能面臨變數，進而牽動半導體產業的併購策略、晶片設計業者的商業模式，以及整體IP授權規則。
paras_en: Qualcomm (QCOM-US) and Arm (ARM-US) are again at an impasse in their chip‑licensing lawsuit, with the jury yet to rule on whether Arm breached the contract or interfered with Qualcomm’s partnership with Meta (META-US). The case will resume next Tuesday, the 13th. The outcome could affect CPU‑architecture licensing, chip mergers and the competitive landscape of the semiconductor sector.

According to Reuters, the five‑day trial marks the second time in two years the two companies have faced each other in court. After SoftBank Group acquired control of Arm in 2016, Arm gradually shifted from licensing the technology needed to manufacture chips to selling its own chips, altering the nature of the partnership.
The crux of the dispute is whether Qualcomm can reach an agreement with Arm on licensing terms for a new architecture before the existing Arm compute‑architecture license expires in 2033.

The controversy stems from Qualcomm’s 2021 acquisition of chip‑design firm Nuvia. Nuvia had previously obtained licenses for Arm‑related architectures, and Qualcomm hopes to integrate that technology into its own Oryon CPU architecture for PCs, smartphones and AI compute platforms.

Arm argues that the Nuvia licensing agreement does not automatically transfer to Qualcomm and demands that Qualcomm cease using the related technology. Qualcomm maintains that it already holds a valid Arm architecture license that runs through 2033.

Analysts note that the lawsuit highlights the widening strategic gap between Qualcomm and Arm. Arm historically partnered with chip designers by licensing CPU architectures, but in recent years has aggressively expanded into its own chip and system solutions, seeking to break out of the traditional licensing model.
Qualcomm, by integrating Nuvia’s technology, is bolstering its own CPU design capabilities and reducing reliance on external architecture licenses, turning the relationship increasingly competitive.

The verdict could shape how chip makers acquire and use CPU‑architecture licenses. If Arm wins, it could tighten its control over licensing terms; if Qualcomm prevails, it may encourage firms to obtain technology licenses through acquisitions and spur greater investment in in‑house CPU development.
On Friday, after roughly four hours of deliberation, the jury was still unable to reach a decision and indicated that deliberations would resume on Tuesday.

Qualcomm wants the jury to find that Arm withheld the software patches and tools needed for Qualcomm’s chip designs, violating their licensing agreement, and that Arm also breached a separate agreement that caps the price Qualcomm must pay for Arm processor designs at no more than ten percent above the minimum price.

Qualcomm also seeks a finding that Arm attempted to sabotage Qualcomm’s commercial partnership with Meta. Qualcomm alleges that in 2024 Arm leaked a letter to Bloomberg that accused Qualcomm of violating a key licensing agreement.

Arm’s legal team this week tried to steer the jury toward another claim—that Qualcomm suffered no damages from the allegations in the lawsuit. Arm describes the case as a fight over who controls licensing terms, with Qualcomm using the dispute to apply negotiating pressure.

This week the parties also pursued a separate judge‑run proceeding on whether Arm engaged in good‑faith negotiations over the licensing terms. That decision, however, is unlikely to be issued until after the jury reaches a verdict on Friday.

The case is being heard in the federal court in Wilmington, Delaware, and revisits many of the same issues from the 2024 trial, when Arm failed to convince the jury that Qualcomm had breached their licensing agreement.
Both trials featured testimony from Arm CEO Rene Haas and Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon, and were overseen by U.S. District Judge Maryellen Noreika.
Qualcomm attorney Karen Dunn told the court on Monday that the case is critical for Qualcomm.
She said, “This is very detrimental to us because Qualcomm’s entire chip business relies on Arm and on Arm honoring its contracts and commitments.”

Qualcomm had asked Judge Noreika before the trial began to rule that, under a clause in the licensing agreement, Qualcomm could stop paying royalties within five years if the contract were breached. The judge has not ruled on that, while Arm argues that the royalty‑penalty clause is unenforceable.
Arm lawyer Gregg LoCascio told the jury on Monday, “They have suffered no damage at all.”

Arm has long relied on intellectual‑property licensing as its core business model, unlike Intel (INTC-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US), which design their own CPU architectures. Arm primarily licenses CPU architectures to global chip makers such as Apple (AAPL-US), Qualcomm, MediaTek (2454-TW), Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and numerous automotive chip firms, which build their own processors on Arm’s designs.

Analysts warn that if this lawsuit upends existing industry practices, the way chip makers acquire Arm technology through acquisitions could become uncertain, affecting semiconductor M&A strategies, chip‑design business models and the overall IP‑licensing regime.

items.title: 普丁傳達伊朗停戰構想給川普！俄承諾增供逾400萬噸柴油、美暫緩制裁
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁據報已向美國總統川普轉達伊朗對結束伊朗戰爭的構想。俄羅斯國營媒體週六（10日）報導，普丁是在與伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚（Masoud Pezeshkian）會面後，將德黑蘭對戰爭可能落幕方式的看法傳達給川普。
根據《CNBC》報導，這項消息發布前一天，川普才表示，俄羅斯將向全球市場增加柴油供應，以緩解伊朗與烏克蘭戰事推升能源價格的壓力。美國財政部也已暫時放寬對俄羅斯柴油的制裁，讓俄方得以恢復相關出口。
俄羅斯國際傳真社（Interfax）引述克里姆林宮發言人培斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）報導，普丁是在與佩澤希齊揚達成共識後，向川普傳達相關訊息。
其他俄羅斯媒體則指出，普丁在土庫曼斯坦出席峰會期間與佩澤希齊揚會面後，曾與川普通電話。
不過，報導並未進一步說明伊朗對結束戰爭的具體構想。白宮尚未立即回覆《CNBC》透過電子郵件提出的詢問，無法確認普丁與川普通話的相關報導。

川普稱俄將增供逾400萬噸柴油　美暫緩制裁至2027年4月

川普週五（9日）在社群平台 Truth Social 發文表示，根據他與普丁通話後達成的安排，俄羅斯將向全球市場供應超過400萬噸柴油。
川普指出，俄方將立即供應逾30萬噸柴油，11月再供應50萬噸，隨後立即追加100萬噸。至於另外300萬噸，則將視俄羅斯煉油廠的狀況決定交付安排。
美國財政部週五（9日）也發布一般許可，暫時豁免俄羅斯柴油相關制裁，期限至2027年4月。
在此同時，伊朗持續加大對通過荷姆茲海峽油輪的攻擊，幾乎每天都有船隻遭到攻擊。德黑蘭試圖藉此阻止原油出口回升。
與伊朗革命衛隊關係密切的《法斯通訊社》（Fars News Agency）報導，一名伊朗革命衛隊高階官員週三表示，伊朗將封鎖所有經由荷姆茲海峽的「非法路線」。
中東原油出口9月已回升至戰前水準，主要原因是美軍沿阿曼海岸護送船隻通過荷姆茲海峽。然而，美伊雙方6月簽署、旨在暫停敵對行動並為談判爭取時間的臨時協議，很快便告破局。

items.title: 川普要求澤倫斯基「停炸」俄羅斯煉油廠！喊烏克蘭「該換總統了」
items.title_en: Trump Demands Zelensky Stop Attacking Russian Refineries, Urges Ukraine to Change President
paras: 美俄柴油協議引發美烏關係新一波緊張。美國總統川普週六（10日）公開要求烏克蘭停止攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，甚至建議烏克蘭更換總統，直言如此才能達成協議。此前，美國財政部宣布放寬對俄羅斯柴油貿易的制裁，川普隨後表示，美俄已就俄羅斯向美國及全球市場供應柴油達成共識，引發烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskiy）強烈不滿。
面對華府態度轉變，澤倫斯基形容自己感到「被背叛」，並於10日密集聯繫歐洲多國領導人，討論美方放寬對俄石油產品制裁帶來的挑戰，以及協調後續應對措施。
根據陸媒《央視新聞》報導，川普10日面對記者多次追問澤倫斯基相關批評時，雖未正面回應問題，卻隨後主動表態，要求烏克蘭停止攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠。
川普表示，澤倫斯基可以做自己想做的事，但不能攻擊煉油廠，並強調他「最好立刻停手」。
川普還進一步表示，建議烏克蘭更換領導人，認為這樣就能達成協議，甚至直言烏克蘭應該換一位新總統。
川普同日也表示，自己對與俄羅斯總統普丁達成的協議感到滿意。

美俄達成柴油供應協議 澤倫斯基批「被背叛」

引發這波美烏摩擦的直接導火線，是美俄最新達成的柴油供應協議。
美國財政部海外資產控制辦公室（OFAC）9日宣布，將在未來幾個月放寬對俄羅斯柴油貿易的制裁，官方理由是緩解美國國內柴油供應緊張，並抑制油價。
川普同日表示，美俄已就俄羅斯向美國及全球市場供應柴油達成一致。
不過，這項決定引發烏克蘭強烈反彈。澤倫斯基9日接受訪問時表示，自己對美俄達成協議感到失望，甚至有種「被背叛」的感覺。他認為，允許俄羅斯出售石油產品等於「投資戰爭」。
澤倫斯基當晚也透過聲明批評，美方的做法並非夥伴應有的行為，並將這項決定形容為「強大夥伴作出的軟弱決定」。

澤倫斯基密集聯繫歐洲領袖 籲加大援烏與制裁俄羅斯

面對美國對俄能源政策轉向，以及川普公開施壓，澤倫斯基10日轉向歐洲尋求支持。
根據《新華社》報導，澤倫斯基當天在社群媒體表示，已與芬蘭總統斯圖布、法國總統馬克宏、挪威首相史托爾 (Jonas Gahr Støre)及英國首相柏南 (Andy Burnham)等歐洲領導人通話。
各方討論內容包括俄烏戰爭最新情勢、美國放寬對俄石油產品制裁所帶來的挑戰，以及如何協調應對措施並籌備後續會晤。
澤倫斯基呼籲歐洲國家加大對烏克蘭的援助，同時進一步強化對俄羅斯的制裁。
paras_en: The U.S.-Russia diesel agreement has sparked a new wave of tension in U.S.-Ukraine relations. On Saturday, October 10, U.S. President Donald Trump publicly demanded that Ukraine cease attacks on Russian refineries and even suggested that Ukraine replace its president, stating that only then could an agreement be reached. Earlier, the U.S. Treasury had announced a relaxation of sanctions on Russian diesel trade, after which Trump said that the U.S. and Russia had reached a consensus on supplying diesel to the U.S. and global markets, provoking strong displeasure from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

Facing the shift in Washington’s stance, Zelenskyy described himself as feeling "betrayed" and on October 10 he made intensive contacts with leaders of several European countries to discuss the challenges posed by the U.S. easing of sanctions on Russian oil products and to coordinate subsequent response measures.

According to Chinese media outlet CCTV News, on October 10 Trump was repeatedly questioned by reporters about Zelenskyy’s criticisms. Although he did not directly answer the questions, he later took the initiative to state that Ukraine should stop attacking Russian refineries.
Trump said that Zelenskyy could do whatever he wanted, but he could not attack refineries, and he emphasized that he should "stop immediately."
Trump further stated that he recommended Ukraine replace its leadership, believing that this would enable an agreement, even saying that Ukraine should elect a new president.
On the same day, Trump expressed satisfaction with the agreement he had reached with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
The trigger for this U.S.-Ukraine friction was the latest U.S.-Russia diesel supply agreement.

On September 9, the U.S. Treasury Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) announced that it would relax sanctions on Russian diesel trade in the coming months, citing the need to ease domestic diesel supply pressures and curb oil prices as the official reason.
On the same day, Trump said that the U.S. and Russia had reached a consensus on Russia supplying diesel to the U.S. and global markets.

However, this decision sparked a strong backlash from Ukraine. On September 9, Zelenskyy, in an interview, expressed disappointment with the U.S.-Russia agreement and even felt "betrayed." He believed that allowing Russia to sell oil products was equivalent to "investing in war."
That evening, Zelenskyy issued a statement criticizing the U.S. approach as not befitting a partner and described the decision as a "weak decision made by a powerful partner."
Facing the U.S. shift in energy policy and Trump’s public pressure, Zelenskyy turned to Europe for support on October 10.

According to Xinhua, on that day Zelenskyy posted on social media that he had spoken with Finnish President Sauli Niinistö, French President Emmanuel Macron, Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre, and British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, among other European leaders.

The discussions covered the latest developments in the Russia-Ukraine war, the challenges posed by the U.S. easing of sanctions on Russian oil products, and how to coordinate response measures and prepare for future meetings.
Zelenskyy urged European countries to increase aid to Ukraine while further strengthening sanctions against Russia.

items.title: 銅價逼近歷史高點！瑞銀示警供應缺口延續至2030年代初、德銀喊價2.2萬美元
items.title_en: Copper Prices Near Historic Highs! UBS Warns Supply Gap Extends Into Early 2030s, Deutsche Bank Sets $22,000 Target
paras: 倫敦銅期貨週五（9日）收盤逼近歷史高點，全球銅供應吃緊的警訊也持續升高。瑞銀（UBS）、摩根大通(JPM-US) 及德意志銀行(DB-US) 接連示警，電氣化與資料中心建設帶動的需求成長，加上礦場罷工及全球庫存偏低，可能進一步加劇供需失衡，支撐銅價長期走勢。
倫敦銅期貨週五收報每公噸約14,622美元。瑞銀美國股票顧問銷售團隊成員 Théa Ziegler 在報告中指出，銅仍是瑞銀最具信心的大宗商品投資主題之一，電氣化與資料中心建設所帶來的需求，預計將持續超越供應增速。
Ziegler認為，銅的長期基本面依然穩健，未來數年供應增長可能持續落後於需求，為銅價提供支撐。不過，關稅及貿易政策的不確定性，仍可能影響短期市場表現。
她也預期，全球銅供應缺口將持續至2030年代初。在需求持續成長、供應端難以快速擴張的情況下，市場供需緊張局勢恐難迅速緩解。
與此同時，銅供應端再傳警訊。摩根大通拉丁美洲企業信貸研究主管 Natalia Corfield 本週指出，智利 Centinela 銅礦已爆發罷工。該礦場是智利主要銅礦企業 Antofagasta 旗下的重要資產之一。
根據《彭博》報導，發起勞資行動的兩個工會警告，若罷工持續，Centinela 最快可能在約兩週內開始減產。
除了礦場罷工，全球庫存偏低也是市場關注焦點。德意志銀行金屬研究主管 Daniel Ghali 上月指出，全球銅庫存已降至「前所未有的低位」，部分原因是美國與中國持續囤貨，壓縮其他地區可取得的供應。
Ghali並將倫敦銅期貨2027年第二季目標價上調至每公噸22,050美元。
在銅價長期走勢方面，瑞銀也持續看好與銅價高度連動的礦業股。Ziegler點名 費利浦·麥克莫蘭銅金公司(FCX-US) 、First Quantum、Hudbay Minerals Inc.(HBM-US) 及Teck Resources(TECK-US) ，認為這四家公司有望受惠於結構性需求成長，以及供應端難以迅速擴張所帶動的多年銅價上行週期。
paras_en: London copper futures closed on Friday (the 9th) near historic highs, and warnings of tightening global copper supply continued to rise. UBS, JPMorgan (JPM-US) and Deutsche Bank (DB-US) successively cautioned that demand growth driven by electrification and data‑center construction, combined with mine strikes and low global inventories, could further exacerbate the supply‑demand imbalance and support copper’s long‑term price trajectory.

London copper futures settled on Friday at about $14,622 per metric ton. Théa Ziegler, a member of UBS’s U.S. equity advisory sales team, noted in a report that copper remains one of UBS’s most confident commodity investment themes, with demand from electrification and data‑center builds expected to continue outpacing supply growth.

Ziegler believes copper’s long‑term fundamentals remain solid and that supply growth may lag demand for several years, providing price support. However, tariff and trade‑policy uncertainties could still affect short‑term market performance.

She also expects the global copper supply gap to persist into the early 2030s. With demand continuing to rise and supply unable to expand quickly, the tight market conditions are unlikely to ease rapidly.

At the same time, another supply‑side warning emerged. Natalia Corfield, head of Latin America corporate credit research at JPMorgan, said this week that Chile’s Centinela copper mine has erupted into a strike. The mine is a key asset of Antofagasta, one of Chile’s major copper producers.
According to Bloomberg, the two unions that launched the labor action warned that if the strike continues, Centinela could begin cutting production in as little as about two weeks.

Beyond the mine strike, low global inventories are also a market focus. Daniel Ghali, head of metals research at Deutsche Bank, noted last month that global copper stocks have fallen to an “unprecedented low,” partly because the United States and China continue to hoard supplies, squeezing availability elsewhere.
Ghali raised Deutsche Bank’s target price for London copper futures for Q2 2027 to $22,050 per metric ton.

Regarding copper’s long‑term outlook, UBS remains bullish on mining stocks that move closely with copper prices. Ziegler highlighted Freeport‑McMoRan (FCX-US), First Quantum, Hudbay Minerals (HBM-US) and Teck Resources (TECK-US) as companies likely to benefit from structural demand growth and a multi‑year upward copper price cycle driven by constrained supply expansion.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元連四周上漲 油價走高壓抑歐元連五周走貶
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises for Fourth Consecutive Week as Oil Prices Climb, Suppressing Euro’s Five‑Week Decline
paras: 美元周五(9日)上漲，歐元則連續第五周下跌。隨著油價回升、抹去稍早跌幅，歐元早盤漲勢逐漸消退。不過，由於法國陷入困境的公債市場趨於穩定，歐元近期的賣壓有所緩和。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.13%，報102.25。美元指數本周上漲約0.3%，連續第四周走高，寫下2025年5月以來最長連漲紀錄。
本周一，歐元兌美元一度跌至1.1161美元，創17個月新低。投資人憂心法國公共債務創下歷史新高，且政府削減預算支出的政治之路困難重重。相較之下，美國經濟與美元則顯得相對強勁。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1198美元，本周累計下跌約0.5%，創下2025年初以來兌美元連續周線下跌最長紀錄。
法國與義大利公債的風險溢價本周有望下滑。這些溢價在9月下旬曾大幅攀升，但隨著投資人等待新的局勢發展，再決定是否要求更高的報酬，以補償財政與政治風險，近期風險溢價已逐步回落。
川普暗示不會攻擊伊朗
周五稍早，全球債券市場趨於平靜。美國總統川普表示，美國不會在11月3日美國期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，並稱美國與德黑蘭當局就戰事進行了富有成果的談判。受此消息影響，油價稍早下跌。
Moneycorp交易與結構型產品主管Eugene Epstein表示，「目前有多項因素同時發揮影響，包括油價走高，以及法國的問題，因此很難判斷究竟是哪一項因素對市場的影響更大。」
「但實際來看，我認為今天市場相對處於觀望狀態。所有人都在等待聯準會(Fed)官員的談話陸續釋出，因為現在可以明顯看出，美元對各位聯準會官員的談話都相當敏感。」
然而，隨著英國海軍相關機構英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)表示，一艘船隻在阿拉伯聯合大公國半島以西13海浬處遭不明飛行物擊中，原油價格隨後自低點反彈。
美國原油上漲0.6%，報每桶92.04美元，盤中最低曾跌至90.01美元。布蘭特原油則上漲0.58%，報每桶104.88美元，稍早最低曾跌至102.33美元。
全球各地債券殖利率近幾周持續攀升，原因包括市場預期各國央行將升息，以及對政府財政狀況的憂慮。
央行政策成焦點
儘管近期經濟數據顯示通膨壓力持續存在，市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍相對有限。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預估，聯準會本月升息至少1碼的機率為19.4%，不過，市場認為12月會議升息的機率高達85.8%。
周五公布的密西根大學消費者調查顯示，由於中東衝突推升生活成本，美國10月初的消費者信心進一步下滑，家庭對經濟前景的看法也因此轉趨悲觀。
儘管多位聯準會官員表示，為了抑制通膨，未來仍有必要進一步升息，但也有官員反對立即升息，並指出聯準會應保持耐心與彈性，再決定未來的利率走向。
法國公債持續承壓，政界人士難以在2027年一場充滿分歧的選舉前有效削減預算赤字。本周稍早，西班牙宣布提前舉行大選，也進一步增加歐元的壓力。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.3235美元，但連續第七周下跌，為2024年11月以來最長連跌紀錄。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 9th), while the euro fell for a fifth straight week. As oil prices recovered, erasing earlier losses, the euro’s early‑session gains gradually faded. However, with France’s troubled sovereign‑bond market stabilising, selling pressure on the euro has eased somewhat recently.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.13% to 102.25. The index is up about 0.3% this week, marking a fourth consecutive week of gains and the longest winning streak since May 2025.

On Monday, the euro slipped to $1.1161, a 17‑month low. Investors worry that France’s public debt has hit a historic high and that the political path to cutting budget spending is fraught with difficulty. By contrast, the U.S. economy and the dollar appear relatively strong.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1198, down about 0.5% for the week, setting the longest run of weekly declines against the dollar since early 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian sovereign bonds are expected to fall this week. Those premiums surged in late September, but as investors await new developments and decide whether higher compensation is needed for fiscal and political risk, the premiums have been gradually retreating.
Trump hints he will not attack Iran

Earlier on Friday, global bond markets steadied. U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not attack Iran before the November 3 mid‑term elections and claimed that the U.S. and Tehran had productive war‑related talks. The news knocked oil prices lower earlier in the session.

Eugene Epstein, head of transactions and structured products at Moneycorp, said, “There are several factors at play right now, including rising oil prices and France’s issues, so it’s hard to pinpoint which factor is having the bigger market impact.”

“In reality, I think the market is in a wait‑and‑see mode today. Everyone is waiting for Fed officials’ remarks to roll out, because it’s clear the dollar is very sensitive to whatever the Fed speakers say,” he added.

However, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a vessel 13 nautical miles west of the UAE peninsula was struck by an unidentified flying object, after which crude oil prices rebounded from their lows.
U.S. crude rose 0.6% to $92.04 a barrel, after dipping to a intraday low of $90.01. Brent crude gained 0.58% to $104.88, after an earlier low of $102.33.
Bond yields around the world have been climbing for several weeks, driven by expectations of rate hikes by central banks and concerns over sovereign fiscal health.
Central‑bank policy is in focus
Even though recent economic data show persistent inflation pressure, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Fed policy meeting remain relatively modest.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 19.4% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least one basis point this month, while the odds of a hike at the December meeting are as high as 85.8%.

A Michigan University consumer survey released on Friday showed that, as Middle‑East conflict pushes up living costs, U.S. consumer confidence slipped further in early October and households grew more pessimistic about the economic outlook.

While several Fed officials have said further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, some have opposed an immediate increase, arguing the Fed should stay patient and flexible before deciding the future rate path.

French sovereign bonds remain under pressure, and politicians find it hard to meaningfully cut the budget deficit before a divisive 2027 election. Earlier this week, Spain announced an early election, adding further pressure on the euro.
The pound rose 0.08% to $1.3235 against the dollar but has been falling for a seventh consecutive week, the longest streak of declines since November 2024.
The dollar gained 0.25% against the yen to ¥158.25. The yen may be on track for a fourth straight week of weakness, down about 0.2% for the week.

items.title: 資金急找避風港！全球貨幣市場基金吸金1538億美元 美股基金轉失血
items.title_en: Funds Scramble for Safe Havens! Global Money‑Market Funds Pull in $153.81 Billion, US Equity Funds Turn Red
paras: 全球債市賣壓加劇，美債殖利率攀高與油價居高不下，加深投資人對通膨的疑慮，促使資金轉向避險。根據LSEG Lipper數據，截至10月7日當周，全球貨幣市場基金淨流入1,538.1億美元，創5月6日當周以來最多；美國股票基金則終止連兩周吸金，遭撤資51.1億美元。
標普500指數本周稍早觸及7,844.52點歷史新高，隨後回落。通膨疑慮引發債市拋售，美國10年期公債殖利率攀抵5.3645%，創2002年4月以來新高，壓抑市場情緒，也促使投資人在股市上漲之際獲利了結。
歐洲債務問題同樣牽動市場。法國預算赤字占國內生產毛額(GDP)比重超過5%，加上明年總統大選恐加劇政治分歧，推升其10年期公債殖利率至4.994%，創24年新高。
全球股票基金當周僅淨流入5.6億美元，為近三周最少。歐洲與亞洲股票基金分別吸金61.9億及61.6億美元，美國則出現9月16日當周以來首次淨流出。其中，美國大型、中型及小型股基金分別失血140.8億、10.3億及8.34億美元。
不過，資金並未全面撤離美股。美國產業型基金仍吸金56.8億美元，以科技類股的45.3億美元居首，公用事業與工業類股也分別吸金11.8億及10.4億美元。
債券基金也持續獲資金青睞。全球債券基金淨流入260.3億美元，創7月8日當周以來最多；其中，美國債券基金吸金197.8億美元，創單周紀錄。美國短中期政府債券與公債基金吸金67.6億美元，為六個月最多，短中期投資等級債券基金另吸金50.4億美元。
美國貨幣市場基金則淨流入684.9億美元，扭轉前一周淨流出436億美元的情況。此外，全球黃金及其他貴金屬基金連續第四周吸金，當周流入14.1億美元。新興市場債券基金吸金14.8億美元，股票基金則連續第五周失血，淨流出7.52億美元。
paras_en: Global bond‑market selling pressure intensified, with U.S. Treasury yields climbing and oil prices staying high, deepening investors' inflation concerns and prompting a shift toward safe‑haven assets. According to LSEG Lipper data, in the week to October 7 the net inflow into global money‑market funds was $153.81 billion, the largest since the week of May 6; U.S. equity funds, meanwhile, ended a two‑week inflow streak with a net outflow of $5.11 billion.

The S&P 500 touched a record high of 7,844.52 points earlier this week before pulling back. Inflation worries sparked a bond‑market sell‑off, pushing the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield to 5.3645%—a peak not seen since April 2002—dampening market sentiment and prompting investors to take profits as equities rose.

Europe's debt issues also weighed on markets. France’s budget deficit exceeds 5% of GDP, and the upcoming presidential election next year could heighten political divisions, lifting its 10‑year sovereign yield to 4.994%, a 24‑year high.

Global equity funds recorded a net inflow of only $560 million for the week, the lowest in nearly three weeks. European and Asian equity funds attracted $6.19 billion and $6.16 billion respectively, while the U.S. saw its first weekly net outflow since the week of September 16. U.S. large‑cap, mid‑cap and small‑cap equity funds lost $14.08 billion, $1.03 billion and $834 million respectively.

Nevertheless, money has not fled U.S. equities entirely. U.S. sector funds still drew $5.68 billion, led by technology funds with $4.53 billion, while utilities and industrials attracted $1.18 billion and $1.04 billion respectively.

Bond funds continued to enjoy inflows. Global bond funds saw a net inflow of $26.03 billion, the highest since the week of July 8; U.S. bond funds alone attracted $19.78 billion, a single‑week record. U.S. short‑ and intermediate‑term government and sovereign bond funds pulled in $6.76 billion, the most in six months, and short‑ and intermediate‑term investment‑grade bond funds added another $5.04 billion.

U.S. money‑market funds recorded a net inflow of $68.49 billion, reversing the previous week’s outflow of $43.6 billion. Meanwhile, global gold and other precious‑metal funds logged a fourth consecutive week of inflows, bringing in $1.41 billion. Emerging‑market bond funds attracted $1.48 billion, while equity funds suffered a fifth straight week of outflows, netting a $752 million withdrawal.

items.title: 史上最大重組月底上路！683家日企逐步從東證指數剔除  逾1兆美元被動資金面臨調整
items.title_en: Largest Reorganization in History Set for End of Month! 683 Japanese Companies Gradually Removed from TOPIX, Over $1 Trillion in Passive Funds Face Adjustments
paras: 日本交易所集團(JPX)周三(7日)公布東證股價指數(Topix)史上最大規模成分股重組，10月30日起生效。按新流動性與自由流通市值標準，683檔現有股票不符納入條件、35檔來自標準市場與成長市場的新股納入。若執行順利，Topix成分股將由8月底約1636檔、兩年內降至約986檔，較現有股數接近腰斬。
這是Topix改革第二階段。第一階段2025年1月已把成分股由約2200檔壓至約1700檔，此次進一步把「上市市場」篩選邏輯改為「交易活躍度＋自由流通市值」，現有公司須滿足年度換手率等流動性要求，並進入自由流通市值前97%。新納入者須進前96%。
未達上述標準者不會即日出局，指數權重按季遞減，至2028年7月降至零，若明年10月重評重新達標可中止減權，2028年10月起改為年度再平衡。
與此同時，被動資金規模使改革備受全球關注。大和證券首席量化橋本淳一上月預估，約166兆日元(1.1兆美元)追蹤Topix。另據瑞銀預估，約155兆日元(1兆美元)，JPX統計則約160兆日元。
被列入剔除名單者面臨指數基金分期減持，新納入如日本麥當勞、東映動畫、叫車平台GO等可獲被動買盤與主動基金關注，但瑞銀日股分析師小林千紗指出，被剔除公司佔家數約三分之一，但佔Topix總市值不到3%，對指數表現與整體流動性的直接衝擊有限，主要影響是个股層面而非大盤方向。
JPX改革目的在提升可投資性與逼出公司治理。近年，JPX社長山道裕己持續推資本效率、股東回報與披露標準；Amundi Japan股票投資主管石原博美認為，成分股縮減「基本正面」，企業須持續證明留指數合理性，若分紅、回購、ROE改善逐案累積，可抬升日股整體評價。部分小型股已提前增加股東回報來降低剔出風險，但主動基金仍要分辨「為保指數而派息」與「真改善治理」的差別。
結構上，JPX新規更重視自由流通市值，有利三菱日聯、豐田、軟銀等大型藍籌股。
高盛分析師Bruce Kirk認為，AI相關大型股指數影響力會再升，東海東京分析師三道翔太則稱小型股剔出風險持續、大盤趨勢可能加強。
短期看，被剔小股有被動賣壓與流動性折價，新納入股有建倉支撐；中長期看，Topix從「廣泛涵蓋全市場」轉向「流動性優先的核心池」，可投資度提升，但也會犧牲小型股、低成交公司的價格發現功能。對追蹤Topix的ETF與退休基金而言，未來兩年再平衡節奏比單日調整更關鍵。
paras_en: Japan Exchange Group (JPX) announced on Wednesday (the 7th) the biggest ever component reshuffle of the TOPIX index, effective October 30. Under the new liquidity and free‑float market‑cap criteria, 683 existing stocks fail the inclusion rules while 35 new stocks from the Standard and Growth markets will be added. If implemented smoothly, TOPIX constituents will drop from about 1,636 at the end of August to roughly 986 within two years, nearly halving the current count.

This is the second phase of the TOPIX reform. The first phase, completed in January 2025, reduced the number of constituents from roughly 2,200 to about 1,700. The current phase changes the "listing market" screening logic to "trading activity + free‑float market cap"; existing companies must meet annual turnover‑rate liquidity requirements and rank within the top 97% of free‑float market cap, while newcomers must rank within the top 96%.

Companies that do not meet the new standards will not be removed immediately; their index weight will be phased down quarterly, reaching zero by July 2028. If they regain compliance in the October review next year, the weight reduction can be halted, and from October 2028 the index will be rebalanced annually.

At the same time, the massive scale of passive capital has drawn global attention to the reform. Daiwa Securities’ chief quant Junichi Hashimoto estimated last month that about ¥166 trillion (US$1.1 trillion) tracks TOPIX. UBS estimates around ¥155 trillion (US$1 trillion), while JPX’s own data put the figure at roughly ¥160 trillion.

Those placed on the removal list will face staged sell‑downs by index funds. New entrants such as McDonald’s Japan, Toei Animation and ride‑hailing platform GO can attract passive buying and active‑fund interest, but UBS Japan‑equity analyst Chisa Kobayashi notes that the companies slated for removal represent about one‑third of the number of constituents yet account for less than 3% of TOPIX’s total market value, so the direct impact on index performance and overall liquidity is limited, affecting mainly individual stocks rather than the market direction.

JPX’s reform aims to improve investability and push better corporate governance. In recent years, JPX President Hiroki Yamaguchi has promoted capital efficiency, shareholder returns and disclosure standards; Amundi Japan equity head Hiromi Ishihara sees the reduction of constituents as "basically positive," arguing that companies will need to continuously prove their relevance to the index, and that incremental improvements in dividends, buybacks and ROE can lift the overall valuation of Japanese equities. Some small‑cap stocks have already increased shareholder returns to lower their exclusion risk, but active managers must still differentiate between "dividends paid just to stay in the index" and genuine governance improvements.
Structurally, the new JPX rules place greater emphasis on free‑float market cap, benefiting large blue‑chip stocks such as Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Toyota and SoftBank.

Goldman Sachs analyst Bruce Kirk believes AI‑related large‑cap stocks will gain even more influence in the index, while Tokai Tokyo analyst Shota Sando says the risk of small‑cap removals persists and could reinforce broader market trends.

In the short term, the removed small caps may face passive selling pressure and liquidity discounts, while the newly added stocks could receive buying support. Over the medium to long term, TOPIX will shift from a "broad market‑covering" index to a "liquidity‑first core pool," enhancing investability but sacrificing price‑discovery for small‑cap and low‑turnover stocks. For TOPIX‑tracking ETFs and pension funds, the rebalancing cadence over the next two years will be more critical than any single‑day adjustment.

paras: 美元周四(8日)走弱，歐元區公債殖利率的升勢暫歇，而市場對聯準會(Fed)今年利率走向的預期大致維持不變。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報102.17，此前一度升至102.46。

歐元區政府公債殖利率再度大幅上升，油價飆漲加劇通膨疑慮，投資人持續拋售法國、義大利等高負債國家的公債。
不過，隨著殖利率升勢逐漸降溫，歐元也從盤中低點回升。法國10年期公債殖利率上升2.7個基點至4.8873%，盤中一度攀升至4.9685%。
在投資人密切檢視法國的債務規模、預算赤字，以及2027年總統大選前的政治前景之際，法國受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
西班牙方面，工會周三宣布將於11月11日發動全國性總罷工，抗議住宅問題，而這場示威距離提前舉行的大選僅剩數周。
Fed釋放升息謹慎訊號
市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍偏低。聯準會周三公布最新一次會議紀要後，顯示決策官員認為通膨是經濟展望面臨的最大風險，分析師則表示，會議紀要並未帶來意外訊號。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，為了讓通膨降至聯準會2%的目標，未來可能仍需要進一步升息，但他也表示升息步調具「彈性」，並為即將舉行的10月會議暫停升息留下空間。
華勒的言論呼應了部分聯準會官員上周的說法，他們均釋放出希望在進一步升息上保持耐心的訊號。
SimCorp多資產投資決策研究主管Christoph Schon表示，「多數其他貨幣似乎都與其貨幣政策預期呈反向關係，但那是因為過去一切都受到美元和聯準會主導，而這種情況在過去幾周仍持續存在。」
「有趣的是，現在還有另一個影響歐元的因素，也就是法國、如今甚至西班牙的政治危機……因此，這是一段短暫的時期，焦點不在利率差或貨幣政策，而是一場非常特殊的歐元危機，而在這個案例中，它正影響歐元。」
市場押注12月升息
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會本月升息至少25個基點的機率僅17.2%，略低於一周前的24.4%。不過，投資人押注12月會議升息的機率則達到81.2%。
在華勒發表上述評論後，高盛分析師在報告中表示，他們仍預期聯準會12月將再升息25個基點，並下調12月不升息的機率，因為華勒的言論代表政策立場轉向更加鷹派。
在更為鷹派的談話中，聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩林(Alberto Musalem)表示，美國央行需要再次升息，才能讓通膨回到2%的目標。
經濟數據方面，美國勞工部表示，上周初領失業金人數減少2,000人至19.7萬人，略低於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的20萬人。最新數據持續顯示美國就業市場保持穩定。
歐元區通膨可能高於目前已經偏高的預測，但歐洲央行(ECB)決策官員壓低了市場對短期升息的押注，多名官員周四表示，從基本面趨勢來看，情況其實較為溫和。
德國公債與法國、義大利等歐元區高負債國家公債之間不斷擴大的殖利率差距，已推動歐元跌至2024年5月以來最低水準。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.07%至1.3219美元，此前英國央行(BoE)總裁Andrew Bailey表示，全球債券市場受到高額借貸與不斷升高的通膨壓力衝擊之際，各國政府需要加倍努力，展現修復公共財政的能力。
美元兌日元下跌0.12%至157.88日元。日本銀行(BoJ)表示，原物料成本上升所帶動的價格漲勢正蔓延至消費品，部分企業提高價格的頻率也有所增加，顯示日銀對通膨壓力擴大的情況感到擔憂。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Thursday (the 8th), pausing the rise in Eurozone government bond yields, while market expectations for the Fed's rate path this year remained largely unchanged.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.08% to 102.17 after briefly climbing to 102.46.
The euro rose 0.08% against the dollar to $1.1204, after dipping intraday to $1.1171.
Eurozone sovereign yields surged again as oil price spikes heightened inflation concerns, prompting investors to continue selling bonds of heavily indebted countries such as France and Italy.
However, as the yield rally cooled, the euro recovered from its intraday low. France's 10‑year yield rose 2.7 basis points to 4.8873%, briefly reaching 4.9685% during the session.
The impact on France was especially pronounced as investors closely examined its debt size, budget deficit, and political outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
In Spain, unions announced on Wednesday a nationwide general strike on November 11 to protest housing issues, a protest taking place only weeks before an early election.
Fed signals cautious rate‑hike stance

Market expectations for a rate hike at the Fed's later policy meeting this month remain low. After the Fed released minutes of its latest meeting on Wednesday, officials said inflation remains the biggest risk to the economic outlook, and analysts said the minutes offered no surprise signals.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that further rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target, but he also noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible,” leaving room to pause at the upcoming October meeting.
Waller's comments echoed remarks from other Fed officials last week, who all signaled a desire to be patient on any further tightening.

Christoph Schon, head of multi‑asset investment decision research at SimCorp, said, “Most other currencies seem to move opposite to their monetary‑policy expectations, but that’s because everything has been dominated by the dollar and the Fed, and that situation has persisted over the past few weeks.”

“Interestingly, there is now another factor affecting the euro – the political crises in France and now even Spain… So this is a short‑term episode where the focus is not on rate differentials or policy, but on a very specific euro crisis that is currently influencing the currency,” he added.
Markets bet on a December hike

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 17.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points this month, down slightly from 24.4% a week ago. However, investors see an 81.2% chance of a hike at the December meeting.

After Waller’s remarks, a Goldman Sachs analyst wrote that they still expect a 25‑basis‑point hike in December and lowered the probability of no hike, interpreting Waller’s comments as a shift toward a more hawkish stance.
In an even more hawkish tone, Alberto Musalem, president of St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank, said the U.S. central bank needs another rate increase to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

On the data front, the U.S. Labor Department reported that initial unemployment claims fell by 2,000 to 197,000 last week, slightly below the Reuters poll forecast of 200,000, indicating the labor market remains stable.

Eurozone inflation may be higher than already elevated forecasts, but ECB policymakers have dampened market bets on a near‑term hike, with several officials on Thursday noting that, based on fundamentals, the situation is actually fairly moderate.
The widening yield gap between German bonds and those of high‑debt Eurozone members such as France and Italy has pushed the euro down to its lowest level since May 2024.

The pound rose 0.07% to $1.3219 after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that as global bond markets face high borrowing and rising inflation pressures, governments need to work harder to demonstrate fiscal repair capability.

The dollar fell 0.12% to ¥157.88. The Bank of Japan said rising raw‑material costs are feeding price increases into consumer goods, with some firms raising prices more frequently, showing the BOJ’s concern over expanding inflation pressures.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元創近18個月新高 Fed會議紀要指今年可能再升息
items.title_en: New York Forex Market: Dollar Hits Near 18-Month High; Fed Minutes Suggest Possible Further Rate Hike This Year
paras: 美元周三(7日) 走強，升至近18個月高點，受到聯準會(Fed)會議紀要顯示可能進一步升息，以及歐元與英鎊走弱雙重支撐。歐元與英鎊受到全球債券拋售潮再度升溫拖累，承受下行壓力。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.4%，報102.24，盤中一度觸及2025年4月9日以來最高。
外匯市場參與者周三關注聯準會9月貨幣政策會議紀要。紀要顯示，多數聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)官員認為，今年年底前還可能再升息一次。
FOMC上個月一致投票決定將聯邦資金利率上調25個基點，為3年多來首次升息。同時，FOMC更新後的點陣圖也暗示今年還可能進一步升息。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)則在會後記者會上表示，讓通膨回落至央行2%的目標，仍是一項重大挑戰。
會議紀要指出，「關於本次會議之後的貨幣政策前景，多數與會者認為，在今年年底前進一步上調聯邦資金利率目標區間可能是適當的。」
紀要也顯示，所有FOMC官員都支持9月升息。
不過，這份紀要公布之際，市場對FOMC本月底再次升息的預期已較9月升息後大幅下降，主要受到近期部分官員偏鴿派的談話，以及美國經濟成長、通膨與勞動市場數據的影響。
根據CME FedWatch工具，目前市場預期本月底維持利率不變的機率接近83%，高於一個月前約54%的水準。
歐元受法國財政危機拖累
美元走強另一助力是歐元周三走跌。歐元兌美元下跌0.6%，至1歐元兌1.1195美元。
隨著法國財政危機惡化，以及西班牙政治陷入僵局，歐洲大陸的市場風險情緒承受壓力。法國10年期公債殖利率已升至2000年初以來未見高點。
法國今年財政赤字預計將達國內生產毛額(GDP)的5.4%，公共債務則接近GDP的120%。
法國政府上周公布2027年預算案，目標透過削減540億歐元的支出，將財政赤字目標控制在GDP的5%。
同時，法國在明年4月與5月舉行兩輪選舉前，也面臨政治不確定性。總統大選領先者、極右派政黨國民聯盟(National Rally)候選人勒龐，以及該黨黨魁Jordan Bardella周二公布主要預算方案，目標在2032年前節省1,400億歐元。
英鎊走弱 英國30年期公債殖利率創1998年來新高
全球債券拋售潮周三蔓延至英國，英國30年期公債殖利率升至1998年1月以來最高水準。
就在一天前，英國財政大臣John Healey才與英國公債市場的主要交易商會面，即所謂的金邊債券造市者(Gilt-edged Market Makers, GEMMs)。
英國財政部表示，與會者討論了英國與全球經濟所面臨的嚴峻外部環境，包括地緣政治發展與金融市場狀況。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.5%，至1英鎊兌1.3213美元。
